thread:
riley_p: Heads up — backfill we kicked off for telemetry resampling is showing ~2x duplicate aggregate counts for some tenants. Suspect sample-rate logic isn't being honored by the replayer.
ava_data: ack. saw the spike on the dashboard. looks like replayer uses ingestion_sample_rate default (1.0) not tenant_sample_override.
matt_console: that matches what I saw in the UI logs — console passes sample_override to ingestion endpoints but replayer job reads from job config only.
sam_sre: is this causing quota blowouts? any noisy tenants we should pause?
jordan_prod: need to avoid user-facing metric regression. can we canary one tenant first and check dedupe rate?
riley_p: plan proposal: add `sample_rate` field to replay job metadata and expose a simple console toggle for "honor tenant sample" vs "force resample". default keep current behavior until rollout.
ava_data: yes. quick patch for replayer would be small — read job.metadata.sample_rate and apply early in the stream.
matt_console: UI suggestion: a small checkbox on the backfill modal "apply tenant sample rate" + a read-only preview of expected output scale.
sam_sre: also add a safety cap: if expected output tokens > xM/hour for that tenant, require explicit opt-in.
riley_p: agreed. adding two controls: sample_rate override and a hard quota check that blocks high-volume runs unless flagged.
backfill-bot: deploy started: replay-job-2026-03-15-42 (job id: rjb-842). status: running (1/10 shards).
ava_data: putting a minimal config sketch here so eng-runtime has something to implement:
```
job_id: rjb-842
tenant_id: tenant-14
sample_rate: 0.25  # honor tenant sample override
safety_cap_tokens: 10000000
mode: replay
```
matt_console: nice. UI will POST that to /api/backfill:start. I'll add `force_sample_override` flag.
jordan_prod: what's the rollout? I'd prefer a canary on 3 small tenants, then 24h monitoring window.
riley_p: canary plan: run on tenants [t3,t7,t14] with sample_rate applied. monitor duplicates (dup_rate), aggregated token throughput, and downstream invoice cost rate. if dup_rate < 5% and cost delta < 10% -> expand.
sam_sre: who owns dashboards/alerts for that? need alert: dup_rate > 10% OR token throughput > safety_cap.
ava_data: I'll add a temporary panel to the telemetry console and create an alert rule in prometheus: increase(telemetry.duplicates[5m]) / increase(telemetry.ingested[5m]) > 0.1.
riley_p: nice. timeline: matt patches UI today, eng-runtime picks up `metadata.sample_rate` tomorrow, canary run after lunch Wed.
matt_console: I pushed a small PR for the modal UX, linking the flag to job payload. will request review from @riley_p and @ava_data.
backfill-bot: rjb-842 shard 1 completed, 2/10 shards running.
sam_sre: remember to throttle replayer concurrency if token throughput climbs. we have global quota windows on the queue.
ava_data: also note: if the original ingest used probabilistic sampling, replaying with a different sample will change distribution; we should include a note in the run summary about expected statistical shift.
jordan_prod: add that note to the modal copy — "applying sample overrides may change dataset distribution; run analytics checks after completion".
riley_p: action items:
- matt_console: add checkbox + force flag to modal and ensure API sends `metadata.sample_rate` (due: today)
- eng-runtime: read `metadata.sample_rate` and short-circuit sampling (due: tomorrow) @sam_sre FYI for concurrency knobs
- ava_data: dashboard + alert (due: before canary)
- jordan_prod: canary approval + communication to CS (due: before canary)

matt_console: on it, pinging reviewers now :rocket:
ava_data: will create alert and temp dashboard panels.
sam_sre: I'll add an automated throttle that suspends new shards if token_rate > threshold.
backfill-bot: rjb-842 status: 5/10 shards complete. ETA ~18m.
riley_p: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in #eng-platform after canary completes and decide expansion. :white_check_mark:
